title: Adjunction after restricted integral-support preservation
statement:
theorem integral_support_adjoint_of_preservation (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f) (E : FieldStage.{u} l)
    (hpres : ∀ K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory l E.carrier X,
      finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E.carrier Y
        ((PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l E.carrier) c).obj K.obj)) :
    ((finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E.carrier Y).lift
      ((finiteTorConstructibleIntegral l E.carrier X).ι ⋙
        PurCompactSupport.image (PurCompactSupport.completed l E.carrier) c)
      hpres).IsLeftAdjoint

proof.text: The proof follows Zheng Construction 5.25: transport normalized finite coefficient systems through extension by zero, proper direct image, strict evaluation and derived completion; the required uniform bounds and adjunction maps are then obtained on the recorded full subcategories. This intermediate conclusion is left for a subsequent worker.
